abstract: Pluripotential embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells do not produce interferon after treatment with a wide variety of inducers, nor are they sensitive to its action. Several differentiated lines derived from the EC cells, however, both produce and are sensitive to mouse interferon. Differentiation of EC cells in vitro is accompanied by development of interferon inducibility and sensitivity.
abstract_ja: 多能性の胎児性癌（EC）細胞は、多種の誘導物質による処理後にインターフェロンを産生せず、その作用に感受性を示さない。しかし、EC細胞由来の分化株のいくつかはマウスインターフェロンを産生し、かつその作用に感受性を示す。EC細胞のin vitro分化に伴い、インターフェロン誘導性と感受性が発達する。
